name: Vargtimmen
why: Bergman's film, proposed under its Swedish title; every English catalogue files it as Hour of the Wolf. On 2026-09-20 JustWatch UK had no page under either name (the US site has one at /us/movie/hour-of-the-wolf), so the alias is there for the day a UK page appears.

name: Dekalog
why: Kieślowski's ten films, proposed under both names (candidates-20.json as Dekalog, cand-c40-r3.json as The Decalogue). The UK page is filed as Dekalog; the English name is what an English list writes, and is the one to try if the Polish one ever stops resolving.
